title: Cross-cycle compliance milestone: evidence staging, owner rotations, and blackout planning
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Background: We need a repeatable cross-cycle milestone pattern that covers automated evidence staging, clear owner rotations for evidence owners, and explicit blackout/cutover windows for audit readiness (SOC2/ISO). Current runbooks are ad hoc: evidence arrives late, owners are overloaded during cutover, and SSO/audit-log artifacts are scattered across infra.

Goals: 
- Create an evidence staging pipeline with automated ingestion, validation, and retention policies.
- Define a 3-step owner rotation template so each cycle has primary/backup evidence owners with handoff checklist.
- Standardize a blackout window playbook (duration, scope, escalation, rollback) for certification cutovers.
- Provide observable SLAs (evidence completeness %, ingestion latency) and dashboard for PM/Eng/Security.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Evidence staging S3 bucket + life-cycle + KMS alias configured and a documented signed-URL workflow available in Confluence.
- Automation (ingest lambda + validation job) marks items as COMPLETE/MISSING with webhook to Slack.
- Owner rotation template published and auto-assigned weekly to oncall via PagerDuty integration.
- Blackout playbook includes explicit rollback steps plus a drill schedule with at least one full rehearsal before due_date.
- Dashboard widgets (evidence completeness, ingestion lag, pending items by owner) available in Console (read-only link shared with auditors).

Scope: 
In-scope: SSO/SAML evidence (SAML metadata, SSO test results), audit logs (retention proofs, storage manifests), policy docs, third-party attestation files. Automation pipelines for ingestion and validation.
Out-of-scope: Redesign of core logging infra or long-term retention policy changes beyond this release (those are tracked in ENG-24111).

Approach / Trade-offs: 
- We will use a short-lived signed-URL pattern to centralize uploads into a secured S3 staging bucket (fast to implement, low infra churn). Trade-off: requires strict KMS key management and PR to ops for alias creation (dependency: ENG-23456).
- Use serverless validator (lambda + step function) to run schema checks and small KV lookup against canonical manifests. Trade-off: limited to small batch sizes; large bulk ingestion will be queued and recomposed by a background job.
- Owner rotation will be templated in Confluence and enforced via a lightweight PagerDuty/Slack auto-assigner rather than full HR rotation automation to keep scope small.

Timeline & checkpoints: 
- 2026-02-20: Project created and initial scoping (this ticket).
- 2026-02-27: Architecture spike complete (S3 + signed-URL, KMS plan).
- 2026-03-06: Implementation kickoff; infra PRs opened (ENG-23456).
- 2026-03-13: Design review and runbook draft ready (this update).
- 2026-03-25: First rehearsal (dry-run ingestion + owner handoff).
- 2026-04-08: Final blackout rehearsal and auditor access check.
- 2026-04-15: Cutover window (targeted completion).

Artifacts / Links: 
- Confluence runbook (draft): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ASSURANCE/Cross-cycle+Evidence+Staging+Runbook
- Implementation PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5821, https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5873
- Dashboard wireframe: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0Bz-assurance-dashboard
- Related linear tickets: PM-6124 (evidence pipeline orchestration), ENG-24111 (log retention refactor).

Risks & mitigation: 
- Risk: Missing or late evidence from third parties. Mitigation: enforce SLOs with automated reminders + escalate to ES with 48h SLA.
- Risk: KMS key rotation impacts signed URLs. Mitigation: coordinate with Security and ops and run key-rotation drill in a staging environment.

Release notes blurb: 
Provide an automated evidence staging pipeline, owner-rotation templates, and a blackout playbook to reduce cutover toil and improve audit readiness.
